hero.paragraph: Packton is a technology-driven logistics network. We are solving the most complex challenges of last-mile delivery in Rwanda by merging physical fleets with digital precision.
hero.imageAlt: Packton courier dispatching a parcel from a branded motorcycle in Kigali

story.headingLine1: Distance should never be a barrier to
story.paragraph1: Before Packton, businesses in Kigali worked with a fragmented delivery market: lost packages, delayed cash remittances, and little to no tracking. We saw a gap, and we set out to close it.
story.paragraph2: Today, we run a single, standardized workflow — from the moment a manifest is uploaded to the second cash lands in your account — so businesses can scale their deliveries without having to think twice about logistics.

pillars.label: Mission
pillars.title: Why we're here
pillars.description: To remove the friction from delivery, giving every business in Rwanda — from a single vendor to a national retailer — a logistics partner they can rely on every time.

pillars.label: Vision
pillars.title: Where we're headed
pillars.description: A Rwanda where distance never limits opportunity — where any business can reach any customer, in any district, with the same confidence as next door.

values.heading: Our Core Values
values.paragraph: The standards that shape every dispatch, every route, and every decision we make at Packton.

items.title: Speed
items.description: Every hour a parcel sits idle costs our partners money. We dispatch fast and deliver faster, so your business is never left waiting on us.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: From pickup to signature, every step is tracked and visible. No guessing where a parcel is — for you, or for the person waiting on it.

items.title: Built to Scale
items.description: Ten parcels a month or a thousand a day — our fleet and our systems grow with your business without breaking a sweat.

items.title: Customer First
items.description: Behind every delivery is a person waiting. We treat every parcel, and every recipient, with the same care we'd want for our own.
